OP1_ASH_01.text: Sixty thousand credits. What're you gonna do with your cut, recruit? Buy your own ship?
OP1_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_01.text: No… Once I have the credits I'll go in with you on a faster, more upgradable ship. I don't really have the yearn to captain my own ship.
OP1_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_02.text: Don't want your own ship, recruit?
OP1_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_03.text: If you're good with co-captain in such an arrangement… then I accept… any ideas about what we should look at? 60'000 cred's won't get us something pretty, but sell this glossy rust bucket and maybe fence stuff we nab on the mission, and we get up to 100'000 cred's-
OP1_ASH_03.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_02.text: Yeah actually. Altenian design; you get more than what you pay for because they're such a pain to upkeep… but…
OP1_DST_02.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_04.text: Let Deena worry about that. I like it. Go on.
OP1_ASH_04.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_03.text: … then we could probably get an assault craft, something fast enough to dodge G-U' forces, hits hard enough that we can accept better paying gigs… Or we could get one of their deep space haulers. About as useful in a fight as this rust bucket, but can carry five times the load and take twice the beating…
OP1_DST_03.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_05.text: Guess we'll have to see what's available after the mission. You read the brief I take it. What's your Sight on this?
OP1_ASH_05.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_04.text: Nab some princess… are the photos real, she-
OP1_DST_04.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_06.text: Srov Princess. She's technically one of our Masters from the order, since you can bet Deena's perky backside that they still think we belong to them. Do you know what that means?
OP1_ASH_06.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_05.text: She has a big sword, can ignite it… and she's rich?
OP1_DST_05.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_07.text: Well, it means she's been told she's special by two different institutions. The Srov and the people of Seonha. She's royalty by birth and power. She's never carried her own bag. She's never been told 'no' by anyone who's survived the conversation. A necessary evil from my point of view.
OP1_ASH_07.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_08.text: I have. She's a Master in the order. I've run into her a handful of times, only long enough to be scolded, whipped or walked past. Haven't actually spoken to her. She probably doesn't remember me other than someone who didn't lick her boots. Stay on target, recruit. The mission.
OP1_ASH_08.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_07.text: Oh.. Well, what I don't get is she is a Master in the order. She's a big deal. Why send two dropout 'flunkies' as they've called us?
OP1_DST_07.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_09.text: I didn't dropout. I left. Dropout implies caring about their order. One doesn't dropout of a space station. One just leaves it.
OP1_ASH_09.speaker: Ashe

OP1_STD_01.text: Hey Cap', some craft is closing with us and planetary ass hats are firing at them... don't you guys hear the explosions?
OP1_STD_01.speaker: Statda

OP1_ASH_10.text: The orbital defence guns aren't aimed at us, and dumb ass pirates trying to board us this close to a planet aren't something I'm worried about. They'll bounce off our shields.
OP1_ASH_10.speaker: Ashe

OP1_STD_02.text: I'm always grateful you're the captain, cap'.
OP1_STD_02.speaker: Statda

OP1_DST_08.text: What does she want us to do, knock the pirates out of the sky? Let the planet defence guns do that.
OP1_DST_08.speaker: Dust

OP1_DST_09.text: Right. I left the Srov too. Which makes me wonder why they would send us. Either this is certain death for us, or… there's more to the story we're not being told. 60'000 credits for a rescue opp is a very tall payment; that tells me 'do not ask questions'.
OP1_DST_09.speaker: Dust

OP1_DST_10.text: Every Srov blade I ever saw was a work of art. Gold, enamel, a name and a legend. Yours looks like it came out of a supply crate.
OP1_DST_10.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_11.text: It did. Standard issue. I keep it clean, I keep it sharp, and it's never once let me down. A blade's a tool, recruit. You start dressing up your tools, pretty soon you're dressing up your reasons.
OP1_ASH_11.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_12.text: You gonna dress that chip out of your guard one of these days?
OP1_ASH_12.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_13.text: It's a weak spot. Next fella hits it there, you'll find out which of you's got more character. (beat) And you still don't light that thing where folks can see it. Not on a Unity world. Not ever.
OP1_ASH_13.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_13.text: I bet I could talk her round. Princesses like me.
OP1_DST_13.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_15.text: So you fancy Melonsi, from the photos? She has some assets I take it you saw.
OP1_ASH_15.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_16.text: That's what gets you killed, if not all at once; it'll end you slowly. We may be Srov rejects, but we have the power inside us. We cannot let our eyes deceive our hearts or minds. Melonsi is poison. Good looking poison, but a deadly venom nonetheless.
OP1_ASH_16.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_15.text: Ashe. Those aren't hitting pirates. They're walking their fire in. On us.
OP1_DST_15.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_17.text: Good eyes, recruit. Get your sword.
OP1_ASH_17.speaker: Ashe

OP2_LDY_01.text: Darlings, I hate to interrupt. Some losers down there are shooting at us.
OP2_LDY_01.speaker: Lady Dusk

OP2_ASH_01.text: What the hell is going on? Who would open fire on us without hailing us first? This is a piece of crap civilian transport, not some dread assault craft.
OP2_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP2_INT_01.text: Vors Assault Craft, this is your final warning… cut your engines… prepare … be boarded.
OP2_INT_01.speaker: Intercom

OP2_DST_01.text: Vors assault craft? This ship couldn't be mistaken for-
OP2_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP3_DNA_09.text: Not like this. Not out here, before anybody ever… just one person. Is that so much to ask?
OP3_DNA_09.speaker: Deena

OP3_STD_04.text: Still here. Still don't know why.
OP3_STD_04.speaker: Statda

OP3_DNA_01.text: Ashe, they're not shooting at the pirates. They're shooting at us. Planetary defence guns. Forward shields are at thirty percent and dropping, and that craft is matching our vector. They're going to board us!
OP3_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP3_DNA_02.text: Hear that whine in the port coupling? That's her telling me she can't take many more.
OP3_DNA_02.dir: softer, a hand on the console
OP3_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

OP3_STD_01.text: Don't worry, everything will be fine, because the cap' said so.
OP3_STD_01.speaker: Statda

OP3_KSB_01.intent: We can get destroyed out here, or land on a space station and kill the bastards trying to destroy us.
OP3_KSB_01.speaker: K'saabu

OP3_DNA_03.text: We are not taking a space station, sweetie.
OP3_DNA_03.speaker: Deena

OP3_STD_02.text: ...Honestly? Not the worst idea I've heard today.
OP3_STD_02.speaker: Statda

OP3_ASH_02.text: We're going straight down. Through their EMP line.
OP3_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_04.text: The planetary EMP shield? Ashe, it'll kill every circuit on this ship. We'll drop like a rock.
OP3_DNA_04.speaker: Deena

OP3_DST_01.text: Companion-class hulls glide without power. Passenger safety regs. Lose everything and she still flies.
OP3_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP3_ASH_04.text: And below that EMP line, their guns can't track a ship with no power signature. We drop through, glide in under the cloud deck, and put down in the slums. Nobody hunts a dead ship.
OP3_ASH_04.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_05.text: They'll shoot us apart before we ever hit the clouds.
OP3_DNA_05.speaker: Deena

OP3_ASH_05.text: Then we don't go in slow. We go in fast and hard.
OP3_ASH_05.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_06.text: ...We are all going to die. (beat) Okay. What do you need?
OP3_DNA_06.speaker: Deena

OP3_ASH_06.text: Spoilers half up when we hit atmosphere. Wings two-thirds out. Any more and the air tears 'em off.
OP3_ASH_06.speaker: Ashe

OP4_LDY_01.text: Darlings, some losers have just attached themselves to my forward embarkation bay. I'd like them remov—
OP4_LDY_01.speaker: Lady Dusk

OP4_STD_01.text: Crap! My rifle's in the med bay!
OP4_STD_01.speaker: Statda

OP4_ASH_01.text: We're gliding. I've got minutes before I need to be back in this chair, or we don't land, we arrive. We split up and flush 'em out. Recruit, you're with me: forward, through the lounge. Deena, Statda, K'saabu: the aft hallway, past the med bay. We meet at the embarkation bay and shut that pod down.
OP4_ASH_01.dir: calm, flat on the deck, already deciding
OP4_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F1_ASH_01.text: Big one first. Always the big one first.
F1_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F1_ASH_02.text: Unity issue armour. (beat, frowning at a body) ...cheap Unity issue armour.
F1_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F2_DNA_01.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. Sweetheart, be good to me.
F2_DNA_01.dir: fight start, hands shaking on her pistol
F2_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

F2_STD_01.text: And that's why you don't stand in a hallway.
F2_STD_01.speaker: Statda

F2_DNA_02.text: ...I love you so much, you horrible, beautiful brute.
F2_DNA_02.dir: bark, after K'saabu's first cannon blast
F2_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

T2_ASH_01.text: Embarkation bay. That's where they're coming in. We close that pod off, or we never stop fighting.
T2_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

T2_DNA_01.text: The bay doors are dead. Everything's dead. The EMP—
T2_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

T2_ASH_02.text: Then we do it the old way.
T2_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F3_ASH_01.text: Even if I was a day one private, I'd still say these damned greaseballs would have to be merc's dressed up in Unity armour.
F3_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F3_ASH_02.text: Don't really matter what they were. Scum paid to kill is all I know.
F3_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F3_DNA_00.text: Why would pirates board us when we're being fired upon by Planetary Defence Forces?
F3_DNA_00.speaker: Deena

F3_DST_02.text: Don't really matter. They won't live long enough to tell anyone about us.
F3_DST_02.speaker: Dust

F3_DNA_02.text: No eating people when anyone else is around! Even pirates!
F3_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

F3_SGT_01.text: The traitors are yonder, open fire!
F3_SGT_01.speaker: Sergeant

F3_KSB_01.dir: if the Sergeant is shoved behind the door
F3_KSB_01.speaker: K'saabu

F3_DNA_01.text: The door's on the passenger-safety battery! Somebody hit that panel!
F3_DNA_01.dir: if she finds the door Insight
F3_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

F3_STD_01.text: Nothing personal. Well. A little personal.
F3_STD_01.dir: bark, if she drops the Marksman
F3_STD_01.speaker: Statda

OP5_DST_01.text: These aren't Unity. Ashe, they had our flight plan. The one we only gave the Srov.
OP5_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP5_ASH_01.text: Then somebody in the Srov talks to folks with candle tattoos. Later. Cockpit.
OP5_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP5_DNA_01.text: I've never... I fix things. I don't...
OP5_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP5_DST_02.text: Hey. You saved my life back there. You're still the person who fixes things. You just fixed us.
OP5_DST_02.speaker: Dust

OP6_DNA_01.text: We're alive. We're alive. Is she okay? Lady Dusk? Talk to me, baby.
OP6_DNA_01.dir: climbing out of the hatch, hair everywhere
OP6_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP6_LDY_01.text: ...Darlings. Never do that to me again.
OP6_LDY_01.speaker: Lady Dusk

OP6_ASH_01.text: We're in a wall on the planet. Told you. Fast and hard.
OP6_ASH_01.dir: brushing glass off his coat, utterly calm
OP6_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP6_MQ_01.text: WHO is going to PAY for my WALL?!
OP6_MQ_01.speaker: Mama Quell

OP6_MQ_02.text: Nobody shoots 'em till I've been paid.
OP6_MQ_02.speaker: Mama Quell
